scheme_name: Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands
other_conditions: Must have installed Solar Water Heating System, Rooftop Solar or Ground Mounted Solar for domestic requirements.
Energy meter must be in running condition.
Electricity bills must be paid up to date.
Meter ownership must be in the name of the beneficiary, who must be present if called for evaluation.
Minimum energy savings must exceed 30% based on past three months average consumption.
benefits_summary: Monetary incentives up to ₹75,000 are offered to domestic, commercial, and industrial consumers based on achieved energy savings.
